name: @zimspace/z-x-execution-runner
description: Fixture-first governed Z-X execution runner foundation.

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:integration && npm run test:failure && npm run build && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:rollback && npm run package:validate && npm run manifest:validate
scripts.db:migrate: node --input-type=module -e "import pg from 'pg';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';const u=process.env.ZX_TEST_DATABASE_URL;if(!u)throw new Error('ZX_TEST_DATABASE_URL required');const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:u});await c.connect();for(const f of ['migrations/0001_execution_foundation_up.sql','migrations/0002_video_maker_phase_engine_up.sql'])await c.query(await fs.readFile(f,'utf8'));await c.end();"
scripts.db:rollback: node --input-type=module -e "import pg from 'pg';import fs from 'node:fs/promises';const u=process.env.ZX_TEST_DATABASE_URL;if(!u)throw new Error('ZX_TEST_DATABASE_URL required');const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:u});await c.connect();for(const f of ['migrations/0002_video_maker_phase_engine_down.sql','migrations/0001_execution_foundation_down.sql'])await c.query(await fs.readFile(f,'utf8'));await c.end();"
scripts.package:validate: node --input-type=module -e "import p from './package.json' with {type:'json'};if(p.name!=='@zimspace/z-x-execution-runner'||p.type!=='module'||p.engines.node!=='>=22 <23'||p.main!=='dist/src/api/main.js'||p.scripts['start:worker']!=='node --enable-source-maps dist/src/worker/main.js'||p.scripts['start:auth-fixture']!=='node --enable-source-maps dist/src/auth-fixture/main.js'||p.scripts['fixture-auth:mint']!=='node --enable-source-maps dist/src/auth-fixture/mint.js'||p.scripts['worker:request-stop']!=='node --enable-source-maps dist/src/worker/request-stop.js'||!p.files.includes('scripts')||p.files.some(x=>x.includes('.runtime')))process.exit(1);for(const [n,v] of Object.entries({...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies})){if(!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(v))throw new Error('dependency not exact: '+n+'='+v)}"
